notation: independently authored alias groups and waivers; findings are computed by thin_passes::alias

cases.name: linear read observes the other logical value
findings: `v_or_b32 v29, v12, 3` (instruction 1) reads v12 through `late`, but on a path to it `late` is not written: v12 holds `early` there, written by `v_xor_b32 v12, v21, 7` (instruction 0). A derived file gives a value's registers to others before its first write: write `late` on every path to the read (all its dwords; a default before the branch), or - when that path never runs (the read's branch taken only when the write's was: one condition) - say so around the read: `with b.alias_ok("late", why=..)`

cases.name: masked write read under its own alias is self consistent
whole read after a lane partial overwrite still detects clobber
findings: `v_or_b32 v29, v12, 1` (instruction 7) reads v12 through `late`, but v12 was written through `early` by `v_xor_b32 v12, v21, 11` (instruction 3) (a partial write over the whole value): `early` and `late` share the register; if they name one value, declare it (same_as), else the write clobbers a value still to be read
